messages:
anya: Heads-up: seeing a cluster of fncall schema_rejects coming from streaming clients in canary-3 starting ~20m ago. Dashboard shows ~3.5x baseline on a couple routes.

devon: Which routes? Any partner traffic? :thinking_face:

anya: Mostly /partner/invoice and /payments/submit. Console link: https://console.redwood.internal/d/fncall?panel=schema_rejects (filtered to canary-3).

rafa: I pulled raw samples. Validator is failing on enum values and nullable fields. Looks like streaming returns chunked JSON frames and our streaming deserializer hands fragments to the validator before adapter.post_process runs, so normalization never happens. Example: 

```
{"path":"$.payload.status","error":"enum_mismatch","expected":["COMPLETED","FAILED"],"actual":"complete"}

# streamed fragment
{"payload":{"id":"inv_77","status":"complete"}}
```

devon: Ah, the batch path runs adapter mapping like {"complete":"COMPLETED"} but streaming skipped it. That would explain partner-specific failures (they use legacy labels).

anya: Short mitigation idea: apply a route-level rollout override to switch canary behavior to SOFT for those problematic routes while we patch streaming. Our rollout system supports route overrides, right?

morgan: yes. We can flip to SOFT for /partner/invoice and /payments/submit. Do that ASAP to stop hard rejects escalating.

ops-bot: rollout override applied: shape-gate-canary-3 /partner/invoice,/payments/submit -> SOFT at 2026-03-23T01:10Z by devops.

rafa: I'll open a fix to ensure adapter.post_process runs for streaming fragments and add the missing enum mapping for legacy labels. Will add an integration test that feeds chunked frames.

rafa: Also proposing we add small telemetry fields on validation events: `validation_phase` = "pre_adapter" | "post_adapter", `adapter_applied` = true|false, and `stream_fragment` = true|false. With those we can break down rejects by pre/post adapter and detect streaming-specific gaps.

anya: Strong +1. Console needs to show fraction of rejects auto-fixed by adapters vs hard rejects to inform rollback decisions during rollouts. A tiny tile would help.

devon: Console-side I can add a compact explorer tile if the validation events include stable fields: `route`, `model_variant`, `validation_phase`, `adapter_applied`. Keep names exact.

morgan: Also enable per-route sampling of failed payloads (PII redaction: emails, cc numbers, tokens) and stash samples in a replay bucket for reprocessing after the fix. Security to sign off on redaction rules.

rafa: PR 5489 opened: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/PR/5489 — fixes streaming postprocess + integration test.

rafa: I'll open telemetry-only PR next to add the fields and bump validation event schema. PR 5490 for telemetry.

ops-bot: PR 5489 created by rafa at 2026-03-23T01:22Z.

anya: Plan recap: 1) route-level canary->SOFT override (done). 2) land streaming adapter fix (PR 5489). 3) land telemetry schema (PR 5490). 4) enable sampling + redaction, replay samples through fixed pipeline, and update dashboard (pre/post adapter counts). 5) re-escalate strict gating if post-adapter rejects return to baseline.

devon: Timeline? Can PR 5489 land within ~3 hours and replay by EOD?

rafa: Aiming to land in ~90m, tests passing locally. Requesting review now.

morgan: I'll expedite redaction review once PRs are up.

anya: Thanks everyone. I'll add checklist and rollback steps to the rollout runbook. :white_check_mark:
